column1: # OpenCode's native interface, traced on tracon's UI origin.
# pinned bundle on the UI origin, the pinned binary behind the mediated gateway,
# a fake upstream model behind the model gateway, and headless Chromium over CDP
# driving a scripted tour. Every row is a request the browser made; `class` is
# what answered it, and `node/tests/opencode_route_trace.rs` re-derives that
# A step named `-probe` is a same-origin `fetch` the tour made from the loaded
# page — same cookie, same origin, same router — rather than a click; it is how
# the deny list and the views whose controls a headless DOM cannot reliably find
# are asked about. Every other step is the app's own traffic.
# class:  page      the app shell, at `/` or a route the app's router declares
#         asset     a file in the pinned bundle
#         boot      the origin's own bootstrap exchange
#         readable  forwarded by the gateway, directory pinned, credential injected
#         stream    the same, proxied as a stream (the one durably replayable one)
#         mediated  decided by tracon before anything reached the harness
#         unavailable  on the matrix, and refused until tracon owns what it makes
#         forbidden the deny list, refused by name
#         not-found nobody's: asked for on purpose, and 404 with no catch-all
